en.topic_title: Nominations open for powerful Election Committee that selects Hong Kong leader and lawmakers
en.topic_summary:
Nominations have opened for the powerful electoral body that chooses both Hong Kong’s top leader and almost half of the territory’s lawmakers.



Hong Kong officials open a ballot box at the Election Committee by-elections counting station on September 7, 2025. Photo: GovHK. 



The nomination period for 982 seats on the 1,500-member Election Committee opened on Wednesday and will run until October 20.
